payload.reason: The evidence provides specific improvements in task success rate and total task reward when comparing the proposed reinforcement learning methods to supervised training methods.

claims.text: The proposed reinforcement learning method improves task success rate by 14.9% to 15.3% compared to supervised learning models.
Reinforcement learning enhances model robustness against diverse dialog situations compared to supervised learning models.
The jointly optimized models outperform both the supervised learning and single-agent RL training baseline models.
